fact: Decreto n.º 5/2025 of 14 July 2025 approved the IDA Additional Financing Agreement of SDR 15,100,000 (22 May 2025) for the Digital Cabo Verde Project, whose Part 1.1 supports the design and implementation of a strategy for Artificial Intelligence and other emerging technologies.
title: Decreto n.º 5/2025, de 14 de julho (Boletim Oficial n.º 60, I Série)
publisher: Conselho de Ministros, República de Cabo Verde
